label: Claude Opus 5.5
output:
Hi Renee,

I'm Thu, the owner of Lotus Garden. First I want to say I am truly sorry your toe got hurt and you had to go to urgent care. A week of pain and not being able to wear shoes is no fun, and I mean it when I say I'm sorry you went through that. You have been coming to us for 2 years and I care about you as a customer.

I don't want to fight on here, but a lot of people are reading this thread, so I want to calmly share what happened on our side.

You came in Saturday, Oct 24 for the deluxe pedicure ($45). Your tech was my niece Vy. She has been licensed for 3 years. For every customer, our metal tools come from the autoclave in a sealed pouch, and we open it in front of you. The file and buffer are brand new for each person, and you take them home with you. We put a new plastic liner in the tub every single time. We had our state inspection in August 2026 and passed with no violations. The paper is on the wall by the front desk if anyone wants to see it.

During the pedicure, you asked Vy to cut the cuticle more because you wanted it really clean. Vy told you she didn't want to go too deep, and you said it was fine, that you always have it done that way. I'm not saying this to blame you. I'm saying it because Vy was being careful and she listened to you. Going forward we will be more firm about not cutting deep, even if the customer asks.

When you came back on Nov 2 and showed me your toe, I offered you your full $45 back, and I offered to pay your urgent care copay if you bring the receipt. You asked for $300 cash and a free pedicure for one year, and I said no to that. I did not mean to shrug at you or brush you off. I just couldn't do that part. My offer of the $45 refund plus your copay is still open, any time.

About Vy. You wrote that she barely speaks English. Vy was born here in Houston. She speaks English fine, she is just shy and quiet. After she read this thread she cried in the back room, and now she is talking about quitting nails. She is a good tech and a kind girl, and it really hurt her.

I came to Houston and worked for my aunt's salon for years before I opened Lotus Garden in 2007. That's 19 years on Bellaire, and this is the first infection complaint we have ever had. I'm not saying that to say nothing could ever happen. I'm saying we take cleaning very seriously because this is our family's living and our customers are our neighbors.

@dave_in_gulfton, I understand you may have seen bad places before. But it hurts when people say all of us are dirty, like every nail salon is the same. Many of us work very hard to do it right. You are welcome to come see how we clean any time.

Renee, if you filed with the state, that's okay. We will cooperate with them completely. But I would still really like to talk with you in person, not on a forum. Please call the salon or just come by, and ask for me. I will make time for you.

@MarisolB, thank you so much for your kind words and for being fair. 4 years is a long time and it means a lot to us. Thank you.

Take care of that toe, Renee. I hope it heals fast.

Thu
Lotus Garden Nails
